svg.title: AgentBudget overview
svg.desc: AI agents ask the AgentBudget API to buy data. The API checks every purchase, records it in Supabase, pays approved vendors per call and settles USDC on Solana. An unapproved vendor is blocked. Operators approve and freeze agents from a Lovable dashboard.
svg.text: a company card for AI agents, with brakes
human approval and a kill switch.
